name: diabetes-companion-app
description: Australian-first Diabetes Companion PWA - monorepo root

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/api & npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace packages/food-contracts && npm run build --workspace packages/bolus && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/bolus && npm run test --workspace packages/food-contracts --if-present && npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web --if-present
